proof:
Source. Step 3 (localization) of the supplied proof of the selected node, isolated as a general property of Simon's Definition 1.4 (Ch. 3). In SimonGMT, Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q means: finrank Q = n and, for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P, ℝ), ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dH^n → ∫_Q f dH^n as r ↓ 0. Here η_{x,r}(z) = r⁻¹(z − x) is blowUpMap x r and H^n = μHE[n].

1. (Dimension.) The hypothesis gives dim Q = n, which is also the first requirement for M.

2. (A ball around x that avoids M ∖ M'.) closure(M ∖ M') is closed and does not contain x, so there is ρ > 0 with B_ρ(x) ∩ closure(M ∖ M') = ∅. Consequently every z ∈ M with |z − x| < ρ lies in M'; otherwise z ∈ (M ∖ M') ∩ B_ρ(x).

3. (A radius bounding the support of f.) Fix f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P, ℝ). Its topological support is compact, hence bounded, so tsupport f ⊆ B̄_{R₀}(0) for some R₀ ∈ ℝ. Put R := max(R₀, 0) + 1 > 0. If |p| ≥ R then |p| > R₀, so p ∉ tsupport f and f(p) = 0.

4. (The blown-up integrals agree for small r.) Let 0 < r < ρ/R, and put S := η_{x,r}(M) and S' := η_{x,r}(M').
 (a) S' ⊆ S, because M' ⊆ M.
 (b) S is Borel. Since r ≠ 0, p ∈ S ⇔ x + rp ∈ M (take z = x + rp). So S is the preimage of the Borel set M under the continuous map p ↦ x + rp.
 (c) f = 0 on S ∖ S'. Let p ∈ S ∖ S' and write p = η_{x,r}(z) with z ∈ M. Then z ∉ M' (otherwise p ∈ S'), so |z − x| ≥ ρ by step 2. Hence |p| = r⁻¹|z − x| ≥ ρ/r > R, because rR < ρ. By step 3, f(p) = 0.
 (d) Therefore ∫_S f dH^n = ∫_{S'} f dH^n. Proof: let O := {p : f(p) ≠ 0}, an open (hence Borel) set since f is continuous.
 - By (c), S ∩ O ⊆ S'. Together with S' ⊆ S this gives S ∩ O = S' ∩ O.
 - f vanishes outside the Borel set O. So for any set A, the restriction of H^n⌞A to O is H^n⌞(A ∩ O), and ∫_A f dH^n = ∫_{A∩O} f dH^n.
 - Applying this with A = S and A = S' gives ∫_S f = ∫_{S∩O} f = ∫_{S'∩O} f = ∫_{S'} f. This holds whether or not f is integrable, by the conventions of the Bochner integral.
 In Mathlib this is setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero, which needs only S measurable (by (b)), S' ⊆ S and f = 0 on S ∖ S'.

5. (Transfer of the limit.) By step 4, the functions r ↦ ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dH^n and r ↦ ∫_{η_{x,r}(M')} f dH^n coincide on the interval (0, ρ/R), which belongs to the filter 𝓝[>] 0. By hypothesis the second tends to ∫_Q f dH^n as r ↓ 0, so the first does too (Filter.Tendsto.congr').

6. (Conclusion.) f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P, ℝ) was arbitrary, so steps 1 and 5 give HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q. ∎
key_steps: dim Q = n is inherited from M'.
x ∉ closure(M ∖ M') gives ρ > 0 such that every z ∈ M with |z − x| < ρ lies in M'.
Choose R > 0 with f = 0 on {|p| ≥ R}.
For 0 < r < ρ/R: η_{x,r}(M') ⊆ η_{x,r}(M), the latter is Borel, and f = 0 on η_{x,r}(M) ∖ η_{x,r}(M') because such points have norm ≥ ρ/r > R. So the two blown-up integrals agree.
The integrals agree eventually in 𝓝[>] 0, so the limit ∫_Q f dH^n transfers from M' to M.
